thesis: Debt free, high margin (about 41% operating margin on TTM revenue 381.1M) regional lime and limestone producer with 439.2M cash at 2026-09-30 and no borrowings, funding a Texas kiln expansion from internal cash flow. Pricing power: 2025 average selling price +5.6%, volume +11.7%, revenue +17.3%. Quality is high; the open question is price, not business.
counterthesis: Momentum has stalled: 9M 2026 revenue +2.9%, gross profit -0.7%, net income -0.6%, Q3 gross profit -2.7% on diesel and Texas kiln integration inefficiency, construction and shingle demand soft. At the single source close of 119.41 the stock trades near 25.6x TTM earnings and about 2.9% TTM free cash flow yield, which already pays for continued growth that the latest quarters do not show. Free cash flow is held down by 70.1M TTM capex.
invalidation: Q4 2026 and Q1 2027 gross profit still falling year over year after the Texas kiln is integrated; gross margin below roughly 45 percent; steel customer volumes reverse; or capex rises without matching volume. Valuation below roughly 20x TTM earnings with stable margins would revisit the watch status.
